description: An empty title triggers the browser's native bubble 'Please fill out this field.'; a spaces-only title triggers Pardner's inline red 'Enter a title that is not only spaces.'. Same mistake, two styles and two wordings.
expected: One inline Pardner message for both cases (e.g. 'Enter a title.').
actual: Native bubble (validationMessage) for empty; custom role=alert text for whitespace.
suggested_fix: Use noValidate on the form and route both cases through the custom trim check and message.

description: With aria-invalid on Title, the field keeps the same mint focus ring; only the small red line below signals the error.
expected: Invalid fields get an error-coloured border in addition to the message.
suggested_fix: Style [aria-invalid=true] inputs with the error colour border, including when focused.
